title: Nine Days of Counting
subtitle: 香烟与戒烟 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 香烟与戒烟（生活与学习·健康与习惯）
meta: 主题语境：香烟与戒烟（生活与学习·健康与习惯）　|　核心词汇：cigarette　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cigarette 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my mother was sent to count ① cigarette she could not smoke, and she said the counting was the whole of the lesson. The ② cigarette, meaning the roll and not the habit, was nine days old and was counted by whoever came last; cigarette, she said, is the only thing in a pocket that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cigarette in that pocket had the same mark, and the ④ cigarette at the end, meaning the one the doctor kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted properly. Cigarette, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cigarette was the whole of the war, meaning the habit it carried and not the roll. The ⑥ cigarette, meaning the habit and not any of that, is the only thing in a war that everybody shares and nobody questions; cigarette, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a roll and a habit. She said the habit is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ cigarette had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the mark. The ⑧ cigarette of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine days and eleven years of counting; cigarette, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cigarette I remember is the one at the end, which was counted in 1972 and is still described as the last in the county. A ⑩ cigarette, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being counted; every cigarette, she said, is a habit that has agreed to look like a roll. She said the habit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 香烟（指那一支烟本身，与那个习惯相对）
C. 固定搭配：count a cigarette 数一支香烟
D. n. 香烟（指口袋里每一支）
E. n. 香烟（指末尾那一支）
F. n. 烟瘾（抽象：它养成的那个习惯）
G. n. 那个习惯（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The cigarette, meaning the roll and not the habit
cigarette was the whole of the war
the cigarette had become a number in a report
The cigarette of the whole thing
A cigarette, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: count a cigarette 意为“数一支香烟”，1952 年母亲被派去数她抽不了的那支香烟。
cigarette 意为“香烟、卷烟”，指那一支烟本身而不是那个习惯，放了九天，由最后来的人数。
cigarette 指口袋里每一支香烟，每一支都是同样的标记。
cigarette 指末尾那一支（医生留下的那一支），是唯一有人认真数过的。
cigarette 意为“烟瘾”，抽象指它养成的那个习惯，父亲说 cigarette 就是那场战争的全部。
cigarette 为抽象用法，指那个习惯本身，是一场战争里人人都分、却没人质疑的东西。
cigarette 意为“香烟、卷烟”，到 1967 年这支 cigarette 成了报告里的一个数字。
cigarette 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九天和十一年的清点。
cigarette 意为“香烟”，我记得的是末尾那一支，1972 年数过，至今仍被说成全县最后一支。
cigarette 为抽象总称，祖母说一支香烟是唯一会因为被认真清点而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年母亲被派去数她抽不了的那支香烟，她说清点才是这堂课的全部。（count a cigarette）
那支香烟，指的是那一支烟本身而不是那个习惯，放了九天，由最后来的人数。（cigarette）
那个口袋里每一支香烟都是同样的标记。（cigarette）
末尾那支香烟，指的是医生留下的那一支，是唯一有人认真数过的。（cigarette）
父亲说 cigarette 就是那场战争的全部，指的是它养成的习惯而不是那一支烟。（cigarette）
1977 年祖母说，一支香烟是唯一会因为被认真清点而变好的东西。（cigarette）
answers: In 1952 my mother was sent to count cigarette she could not smoke, and she said the counting was the whole of the lesson.
The cigarette, meaning the roll and not the habit, was nine days old and was counted by whoever came last.
Every cigarette in that pocket had the same mark.
The cigarette at the end, meaning the one the doctor kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted properly.
My father said cigarette was the whole of the war, meaning the habit it carried and not the roll.
A cigarette, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being counted.
